answer: Assume the operator is lazy, then design for the shortcut: staked peer review with random spot checks makes the cheap path the honest one. Each reviewer stakes per grade, a spot check re-runs one in twenty, and a mismatch burns the stake. Expire standing that is not renewed by fresh work, so an old relic of a good record goes stale in six epochs. A dune of dormant accounts then costs upkeep with no return, and a pearl of an old grade is worth nothing after expiry. The lazy operator quits at the first renewal bill.
